description:
We are a passionate team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, developing Echoes Beyond Earth, an interactive educational experience exploring human-made artifacts left on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We are interested in space exploration, science, technology, research, and creative storytelling.

We welcome enthusiastic collaborators with skills in web development, UI/UX design, graphic design, space science research, content writing, and creative storytelling.
summary: Echoes Beyond Earth is an interactive space-exploration website for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It features a 3D Solar System, abandoned mission archives, Moon and Mars landing maps, historical timelines, NASA live data, and educational quizzes. Its goal is to preserve the stories and scientific legacy of forgotten spacecraft.
details: Echoes Beyond Earth is an interactive website exploring 16 abandoned and retired space missions across the Solar System through interactive maps, a 3D Solar System, timelines, mission stories, and quizzes. It educates students about space history, scientific discoveries, space debris, and planetary protection. Our goal is to inspire curiosity and promote responsible space exploration. We developed it using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages, NASA APIs, and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude. Its creativity lies in combining real space information with interactive storytelling. Our team considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, educational value, user experience, and environmental impact.
